chapter_title_en: The Vassal Tokens and the Blackflame Dragon
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 11 – The Vassal Tokens and the Blackflame Dragon Formation
chapter_meta_description: Snowdragon Mountain’s twelve Zifu Disciples enter the black fog of Mount Oxhorn. Ji Jiuhuo entrusts the clan’s Vassal Tokens to Ji Ning and deploys the Blackflame Dragon Prison Formation for a desperate last stand.
og_title: Desolate Era Chapter 11 – The Vassal Tokens Are Passed
og_description: The siege of Mount Oxhorn begins! Formation expert Nong Zidao breaks the outer maze with a single whip. Ji Jiuhuo gives Ji Ning the clan’s Vassal Tokens and activates the Blackflame Dragon Prison Formation.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch 11 – Blackflame Dragon Rises
twitter_description: Nineteen Zifu Disciples vs a desperate clan. The Vassal Tokens change hands. The Blackflame Dragon Formation awakens. Tactical Xianxia at its finest.
